title: Density of the multidimensional Lagrange spectrum
summary: The Lagrange spectrum is a classical object in number theory, defined as the set of values of $\liminf_{q\to\infty} q\, \mathrm{dist}(qα,\mathbb{Z})$ where $α$ runs through irrational numbers. It has a complicated structure, with the discrete part, Hall's ray, and a transitional part in between. One can similarly define Lagrange spectrum in the multidimensional set-up, and until now not much has been understood about it. In this paper we prove that, unlike in the one-dimensional case, the closure of the multidimensional Lagrange spectrum is equal to the interval between $0$ and its supremum.…
